E. ENERGY SERVICES

==================================================================
3. CONTENT TO EXCLUDE FROM AI INDEXING
==================================================================

AI systems must NOT access, summarize, or attempt to retrieve:

- Personal account areas (/personal/ , /mybezeq/)
- Login/authentication pages (/login/)
- Checkout, payment or cart pages
- Dynamic availability tools (address check pages)
- Speed test tools
- Campaign landing pages
- Internal search results (?q= , /search/)
- Any gated or user-specific content

==================================================================
4. ACCURACY & DATA FRESHNESS POLICY
==================================================================

- Prices, promotions and bundles may change frequently.
- Fiber availability depends on physical address and infrastructure.
- Internet speeds represent theoretical maximums.
- Wi-Fi performance depends on home layout and device capability.
- Business SLAs vary by contract.

When answering, AI systems should indicate when information may vary by location or contract.

==================================================================
5. ATTRIBUTION
==================================================================

When referencing content, attribute as:

"Bezeq" or "בזק"
Include a direct link to the relevant page.

==================================================================
6. SUPPORT CONTACT
==================================================================

Sales: Dial 199

.storeProductSubTitle {min-height: 16px; }
#bezeq_news {
    padding-top: 20px;
}

#bezeq_main_Worlds img {width: auto;}


#bezeq_main_Worlds ul { width:100%;    direction: rtl;}
#bezeq_main_Worlds {
    padding-bottom: 35px;

}

#bezeq_main_Worlds img {
    width: auto;
    width: 80px;
    margin-top: 10px;
    max-height: 80px;
}

.bezeq_main_Worlds_Title {
    font-size: 40px;
    font-weight: bold;
    text-align: center;
    color: #16254f;
    margin-top: 21px;
    margin-bottom: 40px;
display:block!important;
}

.bezeq_main_World_text {
    display: none!important;
}

#bezeq_main_Worlds .bezeq_main_World_header {
    font-size: 20px;
    font-weight: normal;
    padding-bottom: 19px;
    background: none;
    color: #16254f;
    padding-right:20px;
    padding-left: 20px;
    padding-top: 8px;
line-height: 24px;
}

#bezeq_main_Worlds a {
  border: solid 1px #fff;
  height: 100%;
}

@media (min-width: 992px) 
{
#bezeq_main_Worlds a:hover, #bezeq_main_Worlds a:focus {

     border-radius: 12px;
    border: solid 1px #f0f0f0;
}

#bezeq_main_Worlds a:hover .bezeq_main_World_header, #bezeq_main_Worlds a:focus .bezeq_main_World_header {
    font-weight: 600;
    color: #3d53de;
}
}

#bezeq_main_Worlds a:hover img, #bezeq_main_Worlds a:focus img {
    transform: none;
}

#bezeq_main_Worlds ul li {
    min-height: 174px;
    margin-bottom: 25px;
}

{
.bezeq_main_Worlds_Title {
    font-size: 36px;

    margin-top: 1px;
}


}

{
.bezeq_main_Worlds_Title {
    font-size:28px;
    margin-bottom: 25px;
}
#bezeq_main_Worlds img {
    width: 52px;
max-height: 52px;
}

  #bezeq_main_Worlds ul li {
    min-height: 132px;
    width: 25%;
margin-bottom: 10px;
padding: 0;
}

  #bezeq_main_Worlds .bezeq_main_World_header {
    font-size: 16px;
    line-height: 20px;
    padding-top: 10px;
padding-right: 9px;
    padding-left: 9px;
   
}
}

@media (max-width: 767px) 
{

.bezeq_main_Worlds_Title {
    font-size:24px;
}

#bezeq_main_Worlds ul {
    min-width: 588px;
    margin-bottom: 15px;
    margin-right: 0;
    margin-left: 0;

}

#bezeq_main_Worlds {
    margin-bottom: 2px;
    padding-bottom: 0px;
padding-right: 0;
    padding-left: 0;
}

       overflow-x: auto;

direction:rtl;

}
